title: Ittefaq
desc: Dilip Roy is a painter by trade and, despite possessing a beautiful wife called Sushma, he spends most of his time painting. On the day of their anniversary celebration, Dilip is late finishing a painting when a frustrated Sushma snatches the brush from his hand. Furious, Dilip strangles her to death, is arrested and sent to a psychiatric institute.

title: Izzat
desc: Constable Ram Chandra teaches his son Siddharth to be a diligent policeman and lead his life with honesty and dignity. Siddharth follows his advice until circumstances force him to leave his ideals.

title: Zulm O Sitam
desc: Superintendent of Police, Arun, has been assigned to lead the detail in charge of the state's Chief Minister's protection. However, things do not go as planned and the Chief Minister is killed.

title: Train To Pakistan
desc: The film is set in Mano Majra, which is a quiet fictional village on the border of India and Pakistan, close to where the railway line crosses the Sutlej River. The film develops around the love affair of small-time dacoit Juggut Singh (Nirmal Pandey), with a local Muslim girl, Nooran (Smriti Mishra).

title: Qayamat
desc: Two close friends turn enemies when one becomes a criminal and the other, an IPS officer. Wronged by his friend, the criminal swears to take revenge once he returns from prison.
